description: The pie chart in Figure 6 (left) represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, divided into 11 categories. The slices are labeled with dataset names, including XSUMHUL (1.6%, light blue), VITAMINC (13.6%, teal), SNLI (15.4%, orange), SCITAIL (1.2%, dark green), PUBHEALTH (0.6%, light green), MULTINLI (11.3%, dark blue), MULTIFC (0.5%, purple), FEVER (16.1%, red), ANLI (4.6%, light purple), FACTCC (2.6%, brown), and SCIFACT (31.3%, blue), with percentage labels inside each slice. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
